mentions.name: Seaquel
mentions.description: This app is a SQL client with a visual query builder that lets users drag & drop to build SQL queries. It also includes a SQL tutorial section for anyone who wants to learn or refresh SQL knowledge.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Month 2 of building the SQL client I've always wished I had.

One feature I'm especially proud of is the visual query builder. Drag & drop to build SQL queries.

There's also an entire SQL tutorial section for anyone who wants to learn or refresh SQL knowledge.
